description: Entity-link records that must be rejected, each with the reason.

cases.name: confidence_above_one
cases.why: confidence is constrained to the closed interval [0, 1]. A value above one is not a stronger match; it is a scale error, and it would sort above every genuine match.

cases.name: confidence_as_percentage
cases.why: The same error in its commonest form: 88 meaning 88%. Silently dividing by a hundred would be a guess about the caller's intent.

cases.name: negative_confidence
cases.why: confidence has a lower bound of zero.

cases.name: unknown_match_method
cases.why: match_method is an enum, and it is what decides whether a link is deterministic. An unrecognised method cannot be classified either way, and the interface would have to guess how to present it. Note that the normalizer aliases several informal names onto canonical ones -- FUZZY and HEURISTIC both become NORMALIZED, HASHED becomes EXACT -- so a case testing rejection has to use a name with no honest destination.

cases.name: missing_account_id
cases.why: Both ends of the link are required. A link to nothing is not a weaker link; it is not a link.

cases.name: unknown_entity
cases.why: entity_id is a foreign key. The entity must be ingested before anything links to it.

cases.name: valid_to_before_valid_from
cases.why: A link cannot stop being true before it started. Reversed bounds would make the interval empty, and a point-in-time query over it would silently return nothing.
